payload.title: Non-admin users persisted with users.role = MODULE_MANAGER hold manager power in every module: token minting copies the global role and skips site assignments for it, and the module-blind role hierarchy admits it at every MODULE_MANAGER gate in every service
evidence: apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant.service.ts:582-586 (Assign Manager wrote MODULE_MANAGER into users.role for a single module)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/authentication/services/token.service.ts:368-371 (the access token carries users.role as role and roles)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/authentication/services/token.service.ts:593-598 (a global MODULE_MANAGER gets an empty site list, i.e. no site restriction)
libs/backend-common/src/decorators/roles.decorator.ts:82-86 (the role hierarchy has no module dimension)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/hr.resolver.ts:314-316 (for example, any global MODULE_MANAGER may update HR organisation units)
payload.rule_violated: In the section 2 target model and the PKG-02 decision table, users.role is an account role only and the global role never grants module access
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-46, release R6.
